pins.name: D7
pins.label: GPIO7 (Led active high)
pins.notes: PIN_LED — onboard status LED, active-high (same role/polarity convention as every other Adafruit RP2040/RP2350 Feather PIN_LED in this repo, e.g. the RP2040 Adalogger sibling's GPIO13 and the plain Feather RP2350's own GPIO7 LED). Confirmed via CircuitPython's board pins.c (board.LED/D13/IO7 -> GPIO7) and WebSearch confirmation that 'GPIO7 is connected to the #7 LED' on the sibling Feather RP2350 (with HSTX) board, matching this board's own pins_arduino.h PIN_LED=7 exactly. digital_input dropped to match this repo's established led_high precedent for dedicated onboard LED pins. pwm_output kept since arduino-pico's analogWrite() works on any RP2350 GPIO, enabling brightness dimming. Unlike the RP2040 sibling (where GPIO7 was PIN_BUTTON, a separate pin from PIN_LED=13), this board's pins_arduino.h defines no button alias on GPIO7 or anywhere else — no 'button' tag applied; no GPIO-readable BOOT/user button was found documented for this board (RP2350's own Reset/Bootloader-select buttons are separate physical hardware, not exposed as a normal GPIO here).

pins.name: GPIO13
pins.label: GPIO13
pins.notes:
PIN_CARD_DETECT — onboard microSD card connector's card-presence-detect switch. digital_output/pwm_output dropped: it's a mechanical switch to GND/logic level, so driving this pin as an output could conflict with the socket's own switch state. digital_input retained since reading card presence is a genuine, safe, useful operation. Confirmed via CircuitPython's mpconfigboard.h (card detect on GPIO13, default insertion state=false) and this board's own pins_arduino.h, matching this repo's adafruit_feather_adalogger (RP2040 sibling) and solderparty_rp2350_stamp PIN_CARD_DETECT precedent. BUG FIX: this GPIO was also the vendor's default (arbitrary, unused) PIN_SPI0_SS alias in pins_arduino.h, which would have contaminated this confirmed card-detect tag with a spurious spi_ss capability via build_boards.js's unconditional SS-alias auto-append — removed `#define PIN_SPI0_SS (13u)` and the dependent `static const uint8_t SS = PIN_SPI0_SS;` line (grepped the whole file afterward to confirm no other reference to either symbol remains). See the RP2040 sibling's own PIN_SPI0_SS=13/PIN_LED=13 collision fix for the identical bug class (Adafruit's own docs confirm this SPI0 header has no fixed dedicated CS pin at all).
Check if available on board

pins.name: GPIO14
pins.label: GPIO14
pins.notes:
PIN_SD_CLK / PIN_SPI1_SCK — onboard microSD card connector's dedicated SPI1 clock line. Not general-purpose. Confirmed via CircuitPython's mpconfigboard.h (SD card SCK=GPIO14) and this board's own pins_arduino.h. spi_sck capability is auto-supplied by build_boards.js from this board's SPI1 SCK alias, matching this repo's RP2040-sibling/sparkfun_thingplusrp2040/solderparty_rp2350_stamp SD-card exclusion precedent.
Check if available on board

pins.name: GPIO17
pins.label: GPIO17
pins.notes:
PIN_SD_DAT1 — onboard microSD card connector's dedicated 4-bit-SDIO DAT1 line (unused in the default 1-bit SPI mode this core uses, but still physically dedicated to the card socket). Not general-purpose. No SPI-role alias in pins_arduino.h, so no bus-role tag applies either, matching this repo's RP2040-sibling/sparkfun_thingplusrp2040 DAT1/DAT2 precedent.

pins.name: GPIO19
pins.label: GPIO19
pins.notes:
PIN_SD_DAT3_CS / PIN_SPI1_SS — onboard microSD card connector's dedicated SPI1 chip-select line. Not general-purpose. Confirmed via CircuitPython's mpconfigboard.h (SD card Chip Select=GPIO19) and this board's own pins_arduino.h. spi_ss capability is auto-supplied by build_boards.js from this board's SPI1 SS alias — this one is correct/intentional (reflects the pin's real dedicated SD-card SPI1 CS role), unlike the removed GPIO13 PIN_SPI0_SS false alias above.

pins.name: D21
pins.label: GPIO21 (Led Neopixel)
pins.notes: PIN_NEOPIXEL — onboard single status NeoPixel (WS2812), output-only data line. Confirmed via this board's own pins_arduino.h (PIN_NEOPIXEL=21u, NUM_NEOPIXEL=1) and CircuitPython's mpconfigboard.h/pins.c (NeoPixel on GPIO21, single pixel), matching this repo's led_neopixel precedent (RP2040 sibling's GPIO17, adafruit_feather_scorpio GPIO4, adafruit_metro GPIO14).
